label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: The shop's guest checkout refuses the reserved example.com email address that [name] uses as fictional customer data; [name] never uses a real address, so the checkout could not be tested. Not counted as an accessibility result.

reclassified.why: The shop's guest checkout refuses the reserved example.com email address that AccessiPay uses as fictional customer data; AccessiPay never uses a real address, so the checkout could not be tested.

findings.problem: A country and currency dialog in [name] was open on top of the page at the start, with the cookie banner above it. The dialog language did not match the page, and [name] is plain text, not a button, so there is no keyboard way to dismiss it.
The country dialog was a one-way gate. I had to pick a country and press [name] before I could reach the shop, and the currency list is disabled so it cannot be changed on its own.

findings.page: Dark Grey Alpaca Mix Knitted Tee
findings.problem: The size list could not be focused directly by name, and its option names changed after the first Tab (US XS became XS). Pressing Enter on a size gave no spoken confirmation; I only learned it was selected when I read the page again.

findings.page: Dark Grey Alpaca Mix Knitted Tee
findings.problem: After Add to Bag the only sign of success was the basket button name changing to 1 item. There was no announcement or message that the item was added.

Guest checkout refused the email alex.morgan@example.com with the message that it could not be verified. I tried twice and the same alert came back, with no hint what was wrong, so I could not get past the first checkout step.
